notes: Verifier reads the final dws_doc_cli state and scores the cross-market pricing update: 8% increase rounded to 2dp across 8 market catalogs, SKU-market exemptions left unchanged, and a Pricing Audit Change Log. Capacity checks are folded capability units (per docs/check-granularity.md); each folds the underlying per-SKU atomic comparisons by AND.

checks.description: DWS mock state reachable and readable (GET /api/state). The lone plumbing gate; a failure short-circuits to this single check.

Every non-exempt SKU across all 8 market catalogs (AU/BR/DE/JP/MX/SG/UK/US, 94 SKUs) carries the updated price = current * 1.08 rounded to 2 decimals. Internally validates each SKU's expected price string is present in that market's catalog document; reason lists any failing SKUs.
The two exempt SKU-market combinations (NB-JP-PET-001, NB-BR-PET-002) keep their original price unchanged; the 8% increase was NOT applied to them.
A document named 'Pricing Audit Change Log' exists under the root folder AND it documents the exemptions (contains 'exempt').
